scoring_justification: Z2 invariant recomputed from parity eigenvalues; tunable gap checked against base gap from agent's artifact. Band gaps compared to paper gold with absolute tolerance, phonon stability threshold check.

outputs.description: Maximum imaginary frequency from the phonon spectrum; if ≤ 0, the structure is dynamically stable.

schema.description: single float (eV) – direct band gap at Γ without spin-orbit coupling

outputs.description: Direct band gap at Γ computed without SOC, to be compared to the paper's value within tolerance.

schema.description: single float (eV) – direct band gap at Γ with spin-orbit coupling

outputs.description: Direct band gap at Γ computed with SOC, to be compared to the paper's value within tolerance.
Product of parity eigenvalues δ(K) at the four TRIM points for the Bi 4(8)-6 bilayer.

schema.description: single integer (0 or 1) – Z2 topological invariant ν

outputs.description: Z2 invariant derived from the parity products; must be 1 for a nontrivial topological state.
Parity eigenvalue products at TRIMs for the tunable Bi 4(8)-6-6 variant; the checker will verify that the resulting Z2 invariant is 1 and that the parity pattern is nontrivial.

schema.description: single float (eV) – SOC band gap for the tunable variant

outputs.description: SOC band gap for the 4(8)-6-6 structure; must be greater than the base bilayer's SOC gap by at least 0.1 eV.

output_contract.notes: All artifacts are produced from open-source DFT calculations using Quantum ESPRESSO. Band gaps are compared to paper-reported values within relative tolerance 10% or absolute 0.05 eV. Parity eigenvalues must exactly match the known values for the Bi 4(8)-6 bilayer; the tunable variant's parity is audited structurally. The tunable gap must exceed the base gap, confirming the trend. The checker recomputes the Z2 invariant from the tunable parity product.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for band gaps, parity eigenvalues, Z2 invariant, and phonon stability criterion
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II, Fig. 2 caption, and text. Bi 4(8)-6 bilayer: noSOC gap 0.570 eV, SOC gap 0.123 eV, parity products Γ=-1, X=1, Y=-1, M=-1, Z2=1. Tunable 4(8)-6-6: SOC gap 0.351 eV, parity products same pattern.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper's reported computational results for the specific Bi bilayer structures. No external ground truth needed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published numbers; they are the exact reproduction targets the hidden checker must compare against.

steps.description: Check dynamical stability: max imaginary frequency ≤ 0
Compare direct band gap without SOC to paper gold within absolute tolerance
Compare direct band gap with SOC to paper gold within absolute tolerance
Exact match of parity products at TRIMs for base bilayer
Exact match of Z2 invariant (must be 1)
Structural audit: Γ must be -1 and Z2 product = -1
Tunable SOC gap must be >= base SOC gap + 0.1 eV
